name: ofree-engine
description: Fast, zero-configuration LaTeX builds on GitHub Actions

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); process.noDeprecation = true;"
